snp1.2:1.1: Dhaniyasutta. "Pakkodano duddhakhīro 'ham asmi iti Dhaniyo gopo anutīre Mahiyā samānavāso, channā kuṭi, āhito gini, -- atha ce patthayasī, pavassa davassa deva". || ||
snp1.2:2.1: "Akkodhano vigatakhīlo 'ham asmi iti Bhagavā anutīre Mahiy' ekarattivāso, vivaṭā kuṭi, nibbuto gini, -- atha ce patthayasī, pavassa deva". || ||
snp1.2:3.1: "Andhakamakasā na vijjare, iti Dhaniyo gopo kacche rūḷhatiṇe caranti gāvo, vuṭṭhim pi saheyyuṃ āgataṃ, -- atha ce patthayasī. pavassa deva". || ||
snp1.2:4.1: "Baddhā hi bhisī susaṃkhatā, iti Bhagavā tiṇṇo pāragato vineyya oghaṃ, attho bhisiyā na vijjati, -- atha ce patthayasī, pavassa deva". || ||
snp1.2:5.1: "Gopī mama assavā alolā iti Dhaniyo gopo dīgharattaṃ saṃvāsiyā manāpā, tassā na suṇāmi kiñci pāpaṃ, -- atha ce --pe--" || || "Cittaṃ
snp1.2:6.1: mama assavaṃ vimuttaṃ iti Bhagavā dīgharattaṃ paribhāvitaṃ sudantaṃ, pāpam pana me na vijjati, -- atha ce . . ". || || "Attavetanabhato
snp1.2:7.1: 'ham asmi, iti Dhaniyo gopo puttā ca me samāniyā arogā, tesaṃ na suṇāmi kiñci pāpaṃ, -- atha ce . . ". || || "Nāhaṃ bhatako 'smi kassaci,
snp1.2:8.1: iti Bhagavā nibbitthena carāmi sabbaloke, attho bhatiyā na vijjati, -- atha ce . . ". || || "Atthi vasā, atthi dhenupā,
snp1.2:9.1: iti Dhaniyo gopo godharaṇiyo paveṇiyo pi atthi, usabho pi gavampatī ca atthi, -- atha ce . . ". || || "N' atthi vasā, n' atthi dhenupā,
snp1.2:10.1: iti Bhagavā godharaṇiyo paveṇiyo pi n' atthi,| usabho pi gavampatīdha n' atthi, -- atha ce . . ". || || "Khīlā nikhātā asampavedhī,
snp1.2:11.1: iti Dhaniyo gopo dāmā muñjamayā navā susaṇṭhānā, na hi sakkhiti dhenupā pi chettuṃ, -- atha ce . . ". || || "Usabho-r-iva chetva bandhanāni
snp1.2:12.1: iti Bhagavā nāgo pūtilataṃ va dālayitvā nāhaṃ puna upessaṃ gabbhaseyyaṃ, -- atha ce patthayasī, pavassa deva". || ||
snp1.2:13.1: Ninnañ ca thalañ ca pūrayanto mahāmegho pāvassi tāvad eva, sutvā devassa vassato imam atthaṃ Dhaniyo abhāsatha: || ||
snp1.2:14.1: "Lābhā vata no anappakā, ye mayaṃ Bhagavantaṃ addasāma, saraṇaṃ taṃ upema cakkhuma, satthā no hohi tuvam mahāmuni. || ||
snp1.2:15.1: Gopī ca ahañ ca assava brahmacariyaṃ Sugate carāmase, jātimaraṇassa pāragā dukkhass' antakarā bhavāmase". || ||
snp1.2:16.1: "Nandati puttehi puttimā, iti Māro pāpimā gomiko gohi tath' eva nandati, upadhī hi narassa nandanā, na hi so nandati yo nirūpadhi". || ||
snp1.2:17.1: "Socati puttehi puttimā, iti Bhagavā gomiko gohi tath' eva socati, upadhī hi narassa socanā, na hi so socati yo nirūpadhī" ti || || DHANIYASUTTAṂ NIṬṬHITAṂ.
